claim: For the complete bipartite graph \(K_{3,3}\), the Morse complex \(\mathcal M(K_{3,3})\) of acyclic discrete vector fields is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of exactly \(80\) four-spheres: \(\mathcal M(K_{3,3})\simeq\bigvee^{80}S^4\).
integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by a complete finite acyclic-matching verification over the entire face poset; face counts and mod-2 homology are independently cross-checked.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact computation for one natural complete bipartite graph, not a general formula for all complete bipartite graphs. Novelty remains subject to the residual risk of a very recent, non-indexed, or differently phrased duplicate.
title: The Morse complex of \(K_{3,3}\) is a wedge of \(80\) four-spheres
